sql: SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName, sum(fs.ReturnQuantity) / sum(fs.SalesQuantity) AS ReturnRate, sum(fs.ReturnQuantity) AS TotalReturns, sum(fs.SalesQuantity) AS TotalSales FROM retail.FactSales AS fs INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON fs.ProductKey = p.ProductKey INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName ORDER BY ReturnRate DESC
